name: Arnold von Leroy
original_name: アルノルト・フォン・ルロイ
source:
Arnold is the 23rd head of the Leroy family, a direct descendant of Earl Leroy. He is entrusted with the selection of the heir to the Shedre family, a branch of the Leroy family. 

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E6%B0%B7%E3%81%AE%E5%A2%93%E6%A8%99_%E4%B8%80%E6%9F%B3%E5%92%8C%E3%80%813%E5%BA%A6%E7%9B%AE%E3%81%AE%E5%8F%97%E9%9B%A3]Wikipedia[/url].]
